Before you open a hint, write your plan in one line:
Hint 1 · Vault
What do I already know? The cubes are 1, 8, 27, 64, 125.
Hint 2 · Slicer
Check each option twice: is it a square? Is it a cube?
Hint 3 · Roots
Ask what such a number needs: its prime factors must come in groups of 2 and in groups of 3.
YOUR TURN
Name the option that passes both checks.
Use the hints one at a time. Try on your own before you read the next one.
